Repair for the #100 BLOCK (stream not bound), reproduced first. Branch claude-p1/ac4-s1-sampled-frames, new tip 0a9076c4, a fast-forward of main f7d13c64.
- Fix b121cbf2 (= 23f35516 before a gate-inert rebase; code identical, delta is .mote/docs only). SampledFrameSet receipt parameters and identity now include streamIndex.
- Witness: the consumer suite derives a two-Decoded-picture-stream probe from F0 (stream 1 = stream 0 shifted +500 ticks, same geometry, selection and bytes digest). Preconditions are asserted (equal selection and digest, PTS differ by 500). The test was red on 4ce39ec1 (equal identities) and is green now. Named mutant stream-not-in-identity is killed.
- Exact-SHA gate on a git archive of 23f35516: media with tlFatalWarnings, 63 total, 60 passed, 3 skipped (live worker), 0 failed; TEST_EXIT=0, FMT_EXIT=0.
- Mutations: 10/10 named mutants killed by exactly their named test, controls 11/11 before and after, receipt bound to the 23f35516 sources. One earlier attempt hit an sbt project-load NoClassDefFoundError with no totals while other sbt processes ran; that measured infrastructure, was rerun, and is recorded in the README, not counted.
- Own-code sweep: FrameSet has the same pre-existing gap. Filed as bd-01M37ESFCE1SZFTV7NHJEC7SNC, not changed, to keep FrameSet semantics intact per your #86 boundary.
- Evidence: docs/refactor/evidence/ac4-s1-sampled-frames-20260923/ (0a9076c4).
Please re-verify and resolve #100 if satisfied.
